1443-two-poets.title: Two Poets
1443-two-poets.creator: Honore De Balzac
1443-two-poets.description: A book by Honore De Balzac. ere not as yet in general use in small provincial printing establishments. Even at Angoulême, so closely connected through its paper-mills with the art of typography in Paris, the only machinery in use was the primitive wooden invention to which the language owes a figure of speech--“the press groans” was no mere rhetorical expression in those days.

arxiv-1903-10052.title: Measurement of the production cross section for a Higgs boson in association with a vector boson in the H → W ​ W ∗ → ℓ ​ ν ​ ℓ ​ ν H\rightarrow WW^{\ast}\to\ell\nu\ell\nu channel in p ​ p pp collisions at s \sqrt{s} = 13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-1903-10052.description: Abstract A measurement of the Higgs boson production cross sections via associated W ​ H WH and Z ​ H ZH production using H → W ​ W ∗ → ℓ ​ ν ​ ℓ ​ ν H\rightarrow WW^{\ast}\rightarrow\ell\nu\ell\nu decays, where ℓ \ell stands for either an electron or a muon, is presented.

arxiv-2110-09125.title: On generalization of a theorem of Harish-Chandra
arxiv-2110-09125.creator: Taiwang DENG
arxiv-2110-09125.description: Abstract . In this paper under some conditions we generalize a theorem of Harish-Chandra concerning representability of Fourier transforms of orbital integrals. 1. Introduction In this short paper we consider the question of representability of Fourier transform of orbital integrals for general representations of a reductive groups \displaystyle G .

arxiv-2202-04973.title: Floquet-Landau-Zener interferometry: Usefulness of the Floquet theory in pulse-laser-driven systems
arxiv-2202-04973.creator: Tatsuhiko N. Ikeda, Satoshi Tanaka, Yosuke Kayanuma
arxiv-2202-04973.description: Abstract We develop the Landau-Zener transfer matrix theory for the instantaneous Floquet states (IFSs) for quantum systems driven by strong pulse laser. Applying this theory to the pulse excitation probability in two-level quantum systems, we show unexpectedly good quantitative agreements for few-cycle pulses. This approach enables us to qualitatively understand the probability’s peculiar behaviors as quantum path interference between IFSs.

arxiv-2210-05809.title: Constraining Neutrinoless Double-Beta Decay Matrix Elements from Ab Initio Nuclear Theory
arxiv-2210-05809.creator: A. Belley, T. Miyagi, S. R. Stroberg, J. D. Holt
arxiv-2210-05809.description: Abstract As experimental searches for neutrinoless double-beta ( 0 ​ ν ​ β ​ β 0\nu\beta\beta ) decay are entering a new generation, with hopes to completely probe the inverted mass hierarchy, the need for reliable nuclear matrix elements, which govern the rate of this decay, is stronger than ever.

arxiv-2212-01432.title: Machine Learned Interatomic Potential for Dispersion Strengthened Plasma Facing Components
arxiv-2212-01432.creator: E. L. Sikorski, M. A. Cusentino, M. J. McCarthy, J. Tranchida, M. A. Wood, A. P. Thompson
arxiv-2212-01432.description: Abstract Tungsten (W) is a material of choice for the divertor material due to its high melting temperature, thermal conductivity, and sputtering threshold. However, W has a very high brittle-to-ductile transition temperature and at fusion reactor temperatures ( ≥ \geq 1000 K) may undergo recrystallization and grain growth.

arxiv-2312-17012.title: A Generalization of the Sugeno integral to aggregate Interval-valued data: an application to Brain Computer Interface and Social Network Analysis
arxiv-2312-17012.creator: J. Fumanal-Idocin, Z. Takáč, Ľ. Horanská, T. da Cruz Asmus, G. Dimuro, C. Vidaurre, J. Fernandez, H.Bustince
arxiv-2312-17012.description: Abstract Intervals are a popular way to represent the uncertainty related to data, in which we express the vagueness of each observation as the width of the interval. However, when using intervals for this purpose, we need to use the appropriate set of mathematical tools to work with.

arxiv-2411-01275.title: Optimal Private and Communication Constraint Distributed Goodness-of-Fit Testing for Discrete Distributions in the Large Sample Regime
arxiv-2411-01275.creator: Lasse Vuursteen
arxiv-2411-01275.description: Abstract We study distributed goodness-of-fit testing for discrete distribution under bandwidth and differential privacy constraints. Information constraint distributed goodness-of-fit testing is a problem that has received considerable attention recently. The important case of discrete distributions is theoretically well understood in the classical case where all data is available in one “central” location.

arxiv-2502-11936.title: R E S E A R C H A R T I C L E Regimes of spray formation in gas-centered swirl coaxial atomizers
arxiv-2502-11936.creator: D. Sivakumar, V. Kulkarni
arxiv-2502-11936.description: Abstract Spray formation in ambient atmosphere from gas-centered swirl coaxial atomizers is described by carrying out experiments in a spray test facility. The atomizer discharges a circular air jet and an axisymmetric swirling water sheet from its coaxially arranged inner and outer orifices.

arxiv-2505-02706.title: Transverse momentum fluctuations as a probe of thermalization and collective dynamics of QGP Journal: Journal of Subatomic Particles and Cosmology
arxiv-2505-02706.creator: Rupam Samanta, Tribhuban Parida
arxiv-2505-02706.description: Abstract We study fluctuations of mean transverse momentum per particle ( [ p T ] [p_{T}] ) in ultrarelativistic heavy-ion collisions. We show that the steep fall in the variance of transverse momentum fluctuation in ultracentral Pb+Pb collision serves as a natural consequence of the thermalization of the QGP medium.

arxiv-2505-09729.title: State-space gradient descent and metastability in quantum systems
arxiv-2505-09729.creator: Shuchen Zhu, Yu Tong
arxiv-2505-09729.description: Abstract We propose a quantum algorithm, inspired by ADAPT-VQE, to variationally prepare the ground state of a quantum Hamiltonian, with the desirable property that if it fails to find the ground state, it still yields a physically meaningful local-minimum state that oftentimes corresponds to a metastable state of the quantum system.

arxiv-2507-07750.title: New Isobar Models for K + ​ Λ K^{+}\Lambda Electroproduction
arxiv-2507-07750.creator: Jovan Alfian Djaja † and Terry Mart \orcid 0000-0003-4628-2245 ‡
arxiv-2507-07750.description: Abstract The electroproduction of kaon on proton has been studied using two covariant isobar models. The models incorporate propagators and vertex factors developed in our previous works. In total, the current study includes 26 nucleon resonances and 20 hyperon resonances, with spins up to 13 / 2 13/2 .

arxiv-2602-17858.title: Multi-Attribute Group Fairness in k k -NN Queries on Vector Databases
arxiv-2602-17858.creator: Thinh On, Baruch Schieber, Senjuti Basu Roy
arxiv-2602-17858.description: Abstract . We initiate the study of multi-attribute group fairness in k k -nearest neighbor ( k k -NN) search over vector databases. Unlike prior work that optimizes efficiency or query filtering, fairness imposes count constraints to ensure proportional representation across groups defined by protected attributes.

doe-osti-3740783-balancing-opportunity-a.title: Balancing Opportunity and Risk of Onboard Machine Learning for The NGSS Successor
doe-osti-3740783-balancing-opportunity-a.creator: Garner, James
doe-osti-3740783-balancing-opportunity-a.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. Balancing Opportunity and Risk of Onboard Machine Learning for The NGSS Successor

pmc-10598207.title: Three-dimensional non-approximate Coulomb interaction between two trapped quantum particles
pmc-10598207.creator: Nicolás Z Lizama, Sebastián C Carrasco, José Rogan, Juan Alejandro Valdivia
pmc-10598207.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The two trapped quantum particles interacting problem is generalized to three dimensions, and the exact Coulomb potential is used. The system is solved by expanding the wavefunction in terms of the isotropic harmonic oscillator eigenfunctions and Hydrogen atom eigenfunctions independently, showing that each one results in a prime approximation for different domains of the normalized coupling constant of the relative interactions, suggesting that the combination of the basis is enough to build a well-suited base for the non-approximate problem.

pmc-10738812.title: UNDERUTILIZATION OF TRANSITIONAL CARE MANAGEMENT SERVICE AMONG MEDICARE BENEFICIARIES AT HIGH RISK OF READMISSION
pmc-10738812.creator: Chan Mi Park, Ellen McCarthy, Sandra Shi, Brianne Olivieri-Mui, Jieun Jang, Dae Hyun Kim
pmc-10738812.description: The CMS introduced transitional care management (TCM) service in 2013 to improve care transitions from hospital to home and reduce readmission. TCM uptake has been slowly increasing over time; however, it remains uncertain whether TCM is delivered to patients at the highest risk of readmission. We used a 5% random sample of 2015-2019 Medicare fee-for-service claims.

pmc-11692591.title: MULTIDIMENSIONAL SOCIAL RELATIONSHIP AND LONELINESS AMONG OLDER ADULTS WITH COGNITIVE IMPAIRMENT
pmc-11692591.creator: Soobin Park, Sojung Park, BoRin Kim, Takashi Amano, Jihye Baek
pmc-11692591.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). As a modifiable risk factor of cognitive impairment, loneliness has received growing attention in research. By focusing on older adults with cognitive impairment, this study aims to add to the knowledge about the complex association among cognitive impairment, social relationships, and loneliness We explored distinct patterns of multidimensional social relationships and examined how these patterns influence social and emotional loneliness among older adults with cognitive impairments. Data came from the 2018 Health and Retirement Study and aged over 65 years.

pmc-12437120.title: Antidepressant use in bipolar disorder, a case report
pmc-12437120.creator: R M Brito Rey, R Diler
pmc-12437120.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionPediatric bipolar disorder is a severe and disabling condition that affects around 1–3% of youth worldwide. The typical clinical course consists of alternating episodes of depressed or elevated mood, with intervals of well-being. Studies have shown that the onset of bipolar disorder is frequently of depressive polarity, and the long-term affective morbidity is primarily depressive, even in patients who have received treatment.

pmc-12609048.title: Challenges of Conducting Risk‐Benefit Analysis of Early Phase Clinical Trials: Results of a National Survey of IRB Chairs
pmc-12609048.creator: Christine M Baugh, Dragana Bolcic‐Jankovic, Mark Fedyk, Mark Yarborough, Spencer Phillips Hey, Insoo Hyun, Jonathan Kimmelman, Eric G Campbell
pmc-12609048.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Institutional review boards (IRBs) are charged with conducting risk‐benefit analysis for early phase clinical trials that often involve high levels of uncertainty regarding a trial's potential risks and benefits. Our study used a survey of IRB chairs to explore how IRBs conduct risk‐benefit analysis, the unique facets of risk‐benefit analysis for early phase clinical trials and specifically for early phase neurology trials, and what facilitates high‐quality risk‐benefit analysis.

pmc-13088307.title: Analytical Validation of an Annotation Tool for WGS‐Based Pharmacogenomics: Preparing for Clinical Implementation in Pediatric Oncology
pmc-13088307.creator: Meta H M Diekstra, Nienke Biesot, Julie Donders, Eugène T P Verwiel, Alex Janse, Alwin D R Huitema, Lidwien M Hanff, Bastiaan B J Tops, Patrick Kemmeren, Jayne Y Hehir‐Kwa
pmc-13088307.description: Whole genome sequencing (WGS) is increasingly accessible in clinical practice, enabling pharmacogenomics (PGx) integration, including in pediatric oncology. However, the lack of validated software to accurately annotate clinically actionable PGx variants from WGS limits routine implementation. We therefore aimed to identify and validate a PGx annotation tool suitable for clinical use in pediatric oncology.

pmc-13146764.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1709 INTRAVENOUS THROMBOLYSIS BEFORE THROMBECTOMY IN STROKE: A META-ANALYSIS OF RANDOMIZED TRIALS
pmc-13146764.creator: Bowei Zhang, Aoming Jin, Yongjun Wang
pmc-13146764.description: Background and aimsWhether intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) should be administered prior to mechanical thrombectomy (MT) in patients with acute ischemic stroke (AIS) due to large vessel occlusion (LVO) remains uncertain. Trials have failed to demonstrate noninferiority of MT alone compared with bridging therapy using intravenous alteplase, while recent evidence suggests potential benefit with Tenecteplase.

pmc-13356499.title: Immunohistochemical Evaluation of TLR‐4, HSP‐70 and Caspase‐3 Expressions in Lesional Areas of Ecthyma Disease
pmc-13356499.creator: Emine Nur Dincer, Ozlem Ozmen
pmc-13356499.description: BackgroundContagious ecthyma (Orf) is a highly contagious, economically significant disease affecting sheep, goats and wild small ruminants, caused by the resilient Orf virus (ORFV). It produces thick, crusted lesions around the mouth and nostrils, especially in animals aged 3–4 months, sometimes causing near 100% mortality in immunocompromised young animals.

pmc-13377146.title: Multitype hand writing as a digital marker for Parkinson's disease
pmc-13377146.creator: Hao Liu, Huishan Deng, Lan Wang, Xinlu Wang, Mingshu Mo
pmc-13377146.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundHandwriting impairment is a distinctive symptom of movement disorders (MDs), such as Parkinson's disease (PD) and Parkinsonian syndrome (PDS).ObjectivesCustom-designed digital handwriting (DHW) tools were developed to strengthen the diagnosis of MDs.MethodsParticipants with MDs from the Neurology and PET departments at the First Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University were recruited to perform digital handwriting (DHW) tasks, which included drawing a line and a cube, and writing a sentence in Chinese (Ch), English (E), and Korean (K).

pmc-13435466.title: Effects of a cow’s milk protein–free diet as an adjunct to standard therapy in juvenile idiopathic arthritis: a randomized controlled study
pmc-13435466.creator: Seyedeh Fatemeh Hashemi Karouei, Vadood Javadi, Mahboubeh Mansouri, Khosro Rahmani, Niloofar Shashaani, Mahmoud Hajipour, Reza Shiari
pmc-13435466.description: BackgroundJuvenile idiopathic arthritis (JIA) is a chronic autoimmune disorder, characterized by chronic idiopathic joint inflammation in children under sixteen years of age. Emerging evidence suggests that food allergens- particularly cow’s milk proteins may modulate inflammatory pathways, and that their elimination could potentially ameliorate disease activity.

pmc-13672443.title: Kidney disease and surveillance testing in children with Bardet–Biedl syndrome: an administrative data study
pmc-13672443.creator: Gal Finer, Sarah E. Ward, Jeremy Pomeroy, Erica Davis, Sriram Ramgopal
pmc-13672443.description: cific International Classification of Disease, Tenth Revision, Clinical Modification (ICD-10-CM) diagnosis code (Q87.83) in March 2023 provided an opportunity to identify affected children across large administrative datasets and describe coded kidney disease burden, kidney-relevant comorbidities, and documentation of surveillance testing.
